messages:
Jordan: FYI — ACME reported their org-level latency dashboard lost p95/p99 lines after yesterday's ingest canary. They're seeing only avg/p50. Screenshot: https://.../acme_dash.png
Lena: Sorry to hear that — do we have a tenant/org id and panel URL? Any errors in console?
Jordan: org_id=acme-inc, panel url: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/latency?org=acme-inc. No browser errors; panels render but percentile series are missing. Customer says metrics existed earlier.
Kai: I can look. Quick question: is this only org view or also service-level breakdown?
Jordan: Both org and service pages. ACME SRE tried toggling time range and refresh, no luck.
Kai: Reproduced in staging with canary ingest branch on region-us-east. Looks like percentile series are being ingested but labelled differently. Example metric coming in: `latency_summary{quantile="p95",service="api",env="prod"}` used to be `quantile="0.95"` for some dashboards.
Ben: Great catch. We rolled a collector change that normalized `quantile` values to short tokens (`p50`, `p95`, `p99`) but dashboards expect numeric `quantile` tags. Panels used a template var `{{quantile}}` set to `0.95/0.99` which no longer matches.
Lena: So dashboards are filtering on `quantile="0.95"` and therefore drop the series? Can we hotfix at the dashboard side?
Ben: Two mitigation paths: 1) Quick dashboard variable update to accept both formats (`0.95|p95`) or remove the quantile filter; 2) Collector rollback/compat shim to emit both tags. I'm preparing a shim to emit legacy numeric tag alongside the new token.
Kai: For immediate customer unblock, you can run this Grafana panel override: change query from `quantile="0.95"` to `quantile=~"(0.95|p95)"` or remove `quantile` filter entirely. I'll create a short-runbook snippet.
Jordan: Can you confirm ETA to have either a dashboard workaround or collector shim? Customer wants next steps to share with their CTO.
Ben: Dashboard tweak — ~15min test + deploy to dashboards team (30min total). Collector shim rollout across canary+prod — estimate 1.5–2h (canary already building). I'll kick the dashboard change first, then the shim for permanence.
Lena: I'll tell ACME: temporary dashboard filter change within ~30m, permanent shim in ~2h. Any public incident link?
Ben: Creating bridge and incident now — https://incident/RED-7893. support-bot: Incident RED-7893 created by Ben.
Jordan: Thanks. I'll update the customer and paste the bridge. Please ping here when dashboard patch is live so I can confirm with them. :thumbsup:
